text:
Maya: Quick check — are we ready to open the publish gate for the launch post tomorrow AM?
Sam: Draft is done, uploaded to Google Drive, pushed a PR for hero image alt text. link: https://drive.redwood/example
Olivia: I skimmed — need one legal-safe claim tweak on the 2nd paragraph. tagging @Asha for a quick pass.
Asha: on it, will scan and ping back in 30. any hard numbers that need sourcing?
Diego: Yes — the benchmark line that says 'reduces inference cost by 4x' should reference the internal test or be softened to 'up to 4x' until we have the public benchmark.
Maya: Good catch. Can we add a parenthetical link to the benchmark doc or footnote it?
Sam: I can add a footnote and a link to the benchmark PR. want the exact repo path? it's in /benchmarks/optimize-2026
Harper: Also confirm webinar CTA — are we routing registrants into the 'Launch Webinar' nurture in HubSpot? We need UTMs and the form redirect.
Jules: HubSpot form ID: 5b3f-4c2a. Suggested UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_v1
Maya: perfect. Jules can you paste the snippet we'll add to the CTA button?
Jules: snippet below

<button id="cta-register" data-hs-form-id="5b3f-4c2a">Register for the webinar</button>
<script>window.location.href += '?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_v1';</script>

Olivia: small ask — can the CTA copy be 'Get the playbook + register' instead of just 'Register'? conversion was better in tests.
Harper: agree, use longer copy. also set contact owner routing: leads with company size > 500 => Sales AE pool; else, SDR nurture.
Sam: pushed update to the prose and swapped in 'Get the playbook + register' CTA. updated the hero quote to the CTO line we agreed (shortened).
Maya: Asha any blockers on legal?
Asha: Tight on the cost claim. Change to 'up to 4x' and add link to benchmark doc. After that, good from legal.
Diego: I'll update the line and commit.
PublishBot: :robot_face: Reminder scheduled: post goes live 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC if gated false.
Maya: final checklist before we mark gated=false:
- hero image alt text ✅
- CTA + UTM ✅
- legal wording update (Diego) in PR ✅ pending merge
- HubSpot form/test redirect ✅ (Jules)
- embed webinar link (Sam) ✅
- analytics tag QA (Eng) — need confirmation

Sam: Eng tagged @eng-runtime to verify analytics payload. they said they'll smoke-test in staging at 08:00 UTC tomorrow.
Olivia: one more micro copy: meta description — 155 chars max. I put a 148 char draft in the doc.
Maya: awesome. if eng smoke-test passes and legal PR merges, I'm happy to flip publish gate at 08:30 UTC and schedule social.
Harper: social copy + tracking sheet updated. I'll queue the short LinkedIn + thread.
Diego: PR merged with 'up to 4x' + benchmark link.
Asha: legal sign-off confirmed in PR.
Maya: marking last_message_ts now. flipping to gated=false at 08:30 unless anyone objects.
Olivia: no objections from me.
Jules: double-checked HubSpot prefill, all good.
PublishBot: :white_check_mark: Publish gate cleared by Maya. Post scheduled for 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC.
Maya: thanks team! will post a short internal note after publish with lead routing numbers and benchmark snapshot. :party_parrot:
